name: FlowMail Automation
implementation_notes: Ignored the gray presentation canvas and rounded outer screenshot frame.
Rendered the real FlowMail product UI as a full app shell instead of a centered fixed artboard.
Used a persistent desktop sidebar, persistent topbar, and an internally scrollable dotted workflow canvas.
Recreated workflow nodes, dashed connectors, builder palette groups, header controls, and profile footer with local React/SVG primitives.
Regenerated the automation header buttons using the latest inner/inset shadow rules: Test, Save Draft, and Activate use inner_control shadows with elevation none and no outside drop shadow.
The inner shadow strength bucket is recorded as xs with evidence=visually_observed and confidence=0.62; this is a conservative visual judgment from the screenshot, not a pixel-measured value.

Regenerated bounded repeated-content containers with localized scrolling: the desktop sidebar keeps header/footer fixed while the nav list scrolls, and the Automation Builder panel keeps its title fixed while its grouped item body scrolls.

scroll_architecture.desktop: lg:h-screen lg:overflow-hidden app shell; sidebar is persistent with a local scrolling nav body and pinned profile footer; main pane is flex-column; workspace owns overflow; Automation Builder owns an inner scrolling groups body.
scroll_architecture.mobile: normal-flow sidebar with horizontal navigation; workspace keeps a min-width canvas and scrolls horizontally when needed.

commands.summary: Local development server started at http://127.0.0.1:41735/.
Route returns the Vite HTML shell.

browser_checks.summary: Chrome rendered the FlowMail Automation page with expected sidebar, topbar, header actions, builder palette, workflow nodes, add buttons, and dashed connectors. The ignored gray presentation wrapper did not reappear as a centered artboard. The automation header action buttons are recorded and rendered as inner-only control shadows, not outside drop shadows. Sidebar nav and Automation Builder groups use localized scrolling instead of clipping repeated content.
